games.title: Games
games.subtitle: Five ways to think, explore and compete. Pick a game, then beat your best run.
games.signInToRank: Sign in to save your score on the leaderboard.
games.scoreError: Your score was saved on this device, but could not reach the leaderboard.
games.rankTitle: One ranking. Five ways to climb.
games.rankDescription: Your best run in each game adds to your overall score.

code-islands.title: Code Islands
code-islands.description: Program KEPPER across 10 increasingly difficult islands, from simple moves to integrated puzzles.
code-islands.rules: Create a sequence of commands that passes every map in a level. Earn up to three stars per island.

keppy-world.title: Keppy World
keppy-world.description: Explore the 3D island, restore relays, clear jump trials and race timed routes.
keppy-world.rules: Complete every shard, relay, station, jump beacon and timed route. Press Space to jump. A fast, flawless run earns 1000 points.

bug-hunt.title: Bug Hunt
bug-hunt.description: Trace 10 increasingly difficult programs and identify the faulty line in each.
bug-hunt.rules: Select the faulty line in each code sample. Earn 100 points per correct answer; your streak is tracked separately.

logic-circuit.title: Logic Circuit
logic-circuit.description: Connect the right conditions to make the output match the target.
logic-circuit.rules: Solve 10 increasingly difficult logic puzzles. Fewer checks mean a higher score.

memory-grid.title: Memory Grid
memory-grid.description: Watch a path light up, then reproduce its order from memory.
memory-grid.rules: Repeat 10 increasingly long sequences. Two mistakes end the run, but a wrong tap never subtracts points.

world.intro: Explore two islands: cross the bridge, restore relays, jump over obstacles and finish timed routes.
world.stationNearHint: Stay in the cyan ring for 1.4 seconds.
world.stationHint: Enter a station's ring while it glows cyan and stay for 1.4 seconds. If it fades, try the next pulse.
world.hitWarning: Sentry hit! You were pushed back and lost 10 finish-bonus points. Watch the red tracks.
world.nearby: Relay nearby. Press Enter or choose Interact.
world.walkHint: WASD / arrow keys to walk · Space to jump · press Enter near a relay
world.touchHint: Use the direction pad to walk · tap Jump · choose Interact near a relay
world.resetConfirmBody: All progress from this run will be lost.
world.completeDescription: Shards, relays, stations, jump beacons and timed routes are complete. Try a cleaner, faster run to improve your score.
world.fallDescription: KEPPER fell off the island. Your earned score has been saved.
world.wrong: Wrong answer. This relay needs 12 seconds to recover.
world.answerListHint: Enter the numbers in order, for example: 1, 2, 3.
world.sceneFallback: 3D view is unavailable in this browser.

t1.intro: Start with the values below. Perform both steps three times:
t1.code:
a = 2, b = 5
repeat 3 times:
  a = (a + b) mod 7
  b = b + 1
t1.question: What is a at the end?

t2.intro: Update the array from left to right. Add each current element to the next one:
t2.question: What is a[3] at the end?

t3.intro: The array is sorted. Run this binary search:
t3.question: What is l when the algorithm ends?

t4.intro: Rows and columns of a 4×4 grid start at 1. You may move only right or down:
t4.question: How many paths to the finish remain?

t5.intro: Use exactly four bits. When rotating, the leftmost bit wraps to the right end:
t5.code:
1101 XOR 0110
→ rotate the result left by 1 bit
t5.question: What is the decimal value of the result?

t6.intro: The sequence starts with these values and follows this rule:
t6.question: What is f(5)?

t7.intro: You can travel in either direction on every road. Their lengths are:
t7.code:
A—B: 3    A—C: 6
B—C: 1    B—D: 7
C—D: 2    C—E: 9
D—E: 3
t7.question: What is the shortest distance from A to E?

t8.intro: Each time, remove the first number and append a new number to the queue:
t8.code:
queue = [2, 5, 1]
repeat 4 times:
  x = remove first item
  if x is even:
    append x/2
  else:
    append x+3
t8.question: What is the queue after four steps?
